buttonFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verify.subject: Confirm your email for {app}
verify.line: Please confirm your email address to finish setting up your account. The link works for 24 hours.
verify.footer: If you didn't create an account, you can ignore this email.

accountExists.subject: You already have a {app} account
accountExists.line: Someone (hopefully you) tried to create an account with this email, but you already have one.
accountExists.footer: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Your account hasn't changed.

reset.subject: Reset your {app} password
reset.line: We received a request to reset your password. The link works for 1 hour and can be used once.
reset.footer: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {app} password was changed
passwordChanged.line1: The password for your account was just changed.
passwordChanged.line2: If this was you, there's nothing else to do. If it wasn't, reset your password now: that signs everyone else out.
passwordChanged.footer: You're receiving this because of a security change to your account.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to "{household}" on {app}
invite.line1Editor: {inviter} invited you to join the household "{household}" as an {role}, to share budgets, expenses and savings goals.
invite.line1Viewer: {inviter} invited you to join the household "{household}" as a {role}, to share budgets, expenses and savings goals.
invite.line2: Open the link to choose your password and join. It works for {days} days.
invite.footer: If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore this email. Nothing happens unless you accept.
